summary: Pro tier deep decompilation, liquidity drain stress-testing, and privileged access audit for OpenZeppelin TimelockController.

findings.title: Self-Admin Escalation & Execution Order Cancellation Trap
findings.description: TimelockController must not grant executor role to zero address unless explicitly intended for open public execution.

attackSurface.attackVector: Misconfiguration where proposer can schedule immediate un-timelocked upgrade without governance review.

remediation.recommendedAction: Apply verified check-effects-interactions, enforce timelocks, and guard critical state variables.
